sentiment.rationale: The document shows a strong quarter with net income of $15.0B and EPS of $5.24, but forward guidance is only modestly raised: NII ex. Markets guidance increased to ~$92B (from a prior implied level) and total NII to ~$95.5B, while adjusted expense guidance was raised to ~$95.5B primarily due to FX, which is largely bottom-line neutral. Management expresses cautious optimism on the IB pipeline and notes significant persistent risks (tariffs, geopolitics, high fiscal deficits). The score is mildly positive due to the guidance raise, but tempered by the FX attribution and cautious tone.
